narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='c1'/>Double the sides. It is ten squared plus twelve squared.
<bookmark mark='c2'/>Ten squared plus twelve squared is one hundred plus one hundred forty four.
<bookmark mark='c3'/>That makes two hundred forty four, twice too much. Doubling a side makes four times the area.
